name: No consistent misconception
definition: No stable mathematical error pattern across the independent assessment
example_error: Working steps are valid across different equation forms
positive_criteria: Correct or self-corrected reasoning across multiple distinct items
exclusion_criteria: One lucky correct answer or missing working is insufficient
minimum_evidence: Four distinct items with legible working and two independent raters
possible_overlap: M1 M2 M3 M4 may appear in isolated slips

name: Inverse-operation misconception
definition: Consistent selection of a noninverse operation when isolating a term
example_error: From x+7=15 the learner adds 7 to isolate x
positive_criteria: Same noninverse choice in two different items with shown steps
exclusion_criteria: An isolated arithmetic slip or copied wrong number is insufficient
minimum_evidence: Two distinct items with working and two independent raters
possible_overlap: M3 sign handling can look similar

name: Equation-balancing misconception
definition: Transformation changes only one side or treats equality as one-sided
example_error: From 4x+3=2x+15 subtract 2x on the left only
positive_criteria: Unbalanced transformation repeated on two different equations
exclusion_criteria: An omitted written step with a valid equality is insufficient
minimum_evidence: Two distinct items with working and two independent raters
possible_overlap: M1 may coexist with balancing errors

name: Negative-sign misconception
definition: Consistent incorrect handling of a negative sign or signed term
positive_criteria: The same sign rule error appears in two different signed equations
exclusion_criteria: One isolated calculation slip is insufficient
minimum_evidence: Two distinct items with working and two independent raters
possible_overlap: M1 can resemble a sign reversal

name: Coefficient/division misconception
definition: Consistent incorrect handling of a coefficient or division while isolating x
positive_criteria: The same coefficient or division reasoning error appears in two items
exclusion_criteria: An isolated multiplication error is insufficient
minimum_evidence: Two distinct items with working and two independent raters

name: Insufficient or ambiguous evidence
definition: Reasoning is missing conflicting or too weak for a dominant target
example_error: One unexplained incorrect answer with no working
positive_criteria: Unclear steps or unresolved competing categories
exclusion_criteria: Do not promote this category to a training target
minimum_evidence: Teacher discussion or additional assessment evidence required
